description: Access Transfermarkt fixture, squad, and player market value data for football clubs. Note: Site uses AWS WAF anti-bot protection that blocks automated access.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_fixtures: Retrieve match fixture schedule for a club and season; 参数: club_id, season_id, club_name; 必填: club_id
  - get_squad: Retrieve squad/player list for a club; 参数: club_id, season_id, club_name; 必填: club_id
  - get_player_market_values: Retrieve player market values for a club; 参数: club_id, season_id, club_name; 必填: club_id

club_id.description:
Transfermarkt club ID (numeric string).
Examples: "583" for PSG, "79" for VfB Stuttgart, "418" for Real Madrid.
Used by all functions.

season_id.description:
Season ID for fixture retrieval (numeric string).
Format: Year representing the season start (e.g., "2024" for 2024/25 season).
Only used by get_fixtures function.
Default: "2024"

club_name.description:
Club name slug for URL construction (lowercase with hyphens).
Examples: "fc-paris-saint-germain", "vfb-stuttgart", "real-madrid".
If not provided, a generic slug will be used.
Used by all functions.
